intendedChanges.summary: Reduce Seller indemnity from the full Purchase Price to 10%; Buyer can counter with a carve-out for fraud and breaches of fundamental representations.
Increase the signing deposit from $240,000 to $360,000, tying up more Buyer funds.
Limit the consent closing condition to contracts above $50,000 annually; Buyer can counter by including all operationally essential contracts.
Extend representation survival from eighteen to twenty-four months.
Double the included transition instruction from forty to eighty staff hours.
Move the unchanged Confidentiality clause from Section 7 to Section 3.
Replace after business hours with outside business hours as a neutral wording clean-up.
Replace treated with deemed in the counterparts sentence without changing its effect.
